Religion
ing
The ancient Egyptians created a religion based on gods and goddesses. They believed that
their deities or goddesses were in charge of their lives. Animais such as lions, cats and
crocodiles were frequently used to represent their gods.
The Mummies
The ancient Egyptians believed in the concept of afterlife. This was the primary reason for
the ancient ritual of mummification. The body was cloth-wrapped and adorned with
jewels and charms. A mask bearing the likeness of the deceased was placed on the face.
Drinks, food, and riches were buried with the mummy. In 1922, Howard Carter discovered
